name: roughs
title: Roughs
description: A portfolio for picture-book and editorial illustrators, laid out as a book dummy: every project is a small open book drawn in blue pencil on layout-pad white — title on the left page, description on the right, a shaded gutter between and a page number pencilled in each foot corner.

tokens.--font-display: typeface of the name, page titles, project titles on the books, headings and quotations — a picture-book geometric sans
tokens.--font-body: typeface of everything read at length and of the notes under each book — a humanist sans
tokens.--font-pencil: typeface of the page numbers pencilled in the corners of each book
tokens.--text-s: size of the notes under each book, descriptions on the right-hand pages, margin notes, dates, tags, tables, page counts and the footer
tokens.--text-m: size of body text and the menu
tokens.--text-l: size of the opening sentence under a project's title
tokens.--text-book: size of a project title written on its book
tokens.--text-xl: size of page titles and project titles
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of titles and headings
tokens.--weight-title: boldness of the name, titles and headings
tokens.--color-leaf: the paper inside each book, behind the page numbers, and under pictures
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: notes under each book, margin-note labels, dates, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: links, page numbers, the boxed current menu entry, the spread being read and focus rings
tokens.--color-pencil: the blue-pencil lines: book outlines and folds, picture boxes, the rules under the masthead and above the footer, link underlines, frames round pictures, tag outlines and the edge of quotations and code
tokens.--color-gutter: graphite shading down the fold of each book
tokens.--color-wash: the faint blue a book takes on under the pointer, the spread being read, and selected text
tokens.--color-rule: hairlines between margin notes, table rows and posts in a list
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--page-margin: space between the page edge and the sheet
tokens.--space-2: spacing scale — tight: inside books and between notes
tokens.--space-3: spacing scale — base: the padding of a page in a book and the gap between paragraphs
tokens.--space-4: spacing scale — roomy: around page titles and between books across
tokens.--space-5: spacing scale — section: between rows of books and above the footer
tokens.--spread-min: narrowest a book on the work sheet may be — smaller means more books across
tokens.--spread-mini: narrowest a book in the small sheet under a project may be
tokens.--spread-ratio: shape of an open book: width divided by height (1.6 is two portrait pages side by side)
tokens.--overshoot: how far the pencil lines of a book run past its corners
tokens.--cover-max-height: tallest the picture at the top of a project page may be
